existingAccount.preview: Someone tried to sign up with your {brandName} email
existingAccount.body: Someone just tried to create a {brandName} account using this email address, but an account already exists. If this was you, sign in instead — or reset your password if you've forgotten it.
existingAccount.footnote: If this wasn't you, no action is needed — no account was created or changed.

onboardingFollowup.enjoying: It's been a few days since you signed up. I hope you're enjoying {brandName}!
onboardingFollowup.expectation: I'd love to know — what did you expect when you signed up vs. what did you get?
onboardingFollowup.reply: A reply with your thoughts would really help us improve the product for everyone.

otp.heading: Your verification code:
otp.expiry: This code will expire in 15 minutes.
otp.footnote: Do not share this code with anyone. If you didn't request this code, you can safely ignore this email.

resetPassword.body: A password reset was requested for your {brandName} account. Click below to set a new password.
resetPassword.footnote: If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email. Link expires in 24 hours.

welcome.body: Welcome to {brandName}! Your account is ready. Start building, testing, and deploying AI workflows in minutes.
welcome.feedback: For any question or feedback, simply reply to this email: we read every message.
welcome.call: Need help getting started? Read the <link>Nexora guide</link>.
welcome.footnote: You're on the Community plan with 1,000 credits to get started.

abandonedCheckout.preview: Did you run into an issue with your upgrade?
abandonedCheckout.attempt: I saw that you tried to upgrade your {brandName} plan but didn't end up completing it.
abandonedCheckout.help: Did you run into a problem, or have a question? We're here to help.

creditPurchase.body: Your credit purchase of {credits} credits has been confirmed.
creditPurchase.applied: Credits are applied automatically to your workflow executions.
creditPurchase.footnote: Purchased on {date}. View balance in Settings → Subscription.

creditsExhausted.preview: You've used all {credits} of your free {brandName} credits
creditsExhausted.body: You've used all {credits} of your free credits on {brandName}. Your workflows are paused until you upgrade.
creditsExhausted.footnote: One-time notification when free credits are exhausted.

enterpriseSubscription.body: Your Enterprise Plan is now active. You have full access to advanced features and increased capacity for your workflows.
enterpriseSubscription.footnote: Questions? Reply to this email or contact us at <link>{email}</link>

freeTierUpgrade.preview: {brandName}: You've used {percent}% of your free credits
freeTierUpgrade.body: You've used {used} of your {limit} free credits ({percent}%). Upgrade to Pro to keep building without interruption.

tables.warningSubject: You're running low on table space
tables.warningLead: You're running low on table space.

seats.warningLead: You're running low on seats for your team.
seats.reachedLead: You've used all the seats on your plan.

paymentFailed.unable: We were unable to process your payment.
paymentFailed.body: Your {brandName} account has been temporarily blocked to prevent service interruptions and unexpected charges. To restore access immediately, please update your payment method.
paymentFailed.paused: • Your workflows and automations are currently paused
paymentFailed.update: • Update your payment method to restore service immediately
paymentFailed.retry: • Stripe will automatically retry the charge once payment is updated
paymentFailed.footnote: Common issues: expired card, insufficient funds, or incorrect billing info. Need help? <link>{email}</link>

planWelcome.body: Welcome to {planName}! You're all set to build, test, and scale your workflows.
planWelcome.call: Want help getting started? <link>Schedule a call</link> with our team.
planWelcome.footnote: Manage your subscription in Settings → Subscription.

usageLimitReached.leadOrganization: Your organization has reached its monthly usage limit on the {planName} plan.
usageLimitReached.leadUser: You've reached your monthly usage limit on the {planName} plan.
usageLimitReached.paused: Workflow runs, knowledge base search, document uploads, and Chat are paused until the limit goes up.
usageLimitReached.remedyOrganization: Raise the organization usage limit in billing settings to resume.
usageLimitReached.remedyUser: Raise your usage limit in billing settings, or upgrade your plan, to resume.
usageLimitReached.footnote: Sent to the people who manage billing for this account.

usageThreshold.preview: {brandName}: You're at {percent}% of your {planName} monthly budget
usageThreshold.body: You're approaching your monthly budget on the {planName} plan.
usageThreshold.avoid: To avoid interruptions, consider increasing your monthly limit.
